audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 0 and 1 were inverted against their own prose: whys[0] says level 1 is 'a wash' but the chart gave it to Gwen, and whys[1] says she gets her dash online and snips you but the chart called it Skill. Row 4 gave level 6 to Gwen while whys[4] says 'Level 6 flips it for you'.
audit.why: At level 1 Gwen has one E charge and Kayle has one Q — genuinely even. From level 2 Skip 'n Slash plus Snip Snip! true damage beats a melee Kayle. At 6 Divine Ascent and Divine Judgment pull it back to even, but Hallowed Mist still denies her being killed.
audit.corrected: Rows 0, 1 and 4 flipped in both layers as one atomic group to Skill, Gwen, Skill — matching the packet chart — with their phases[].why lines rewritten. Rows 2, 3 and 5 left with Gwen, which is what the Gwen-side audit settled on.

audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is named as the tracked cooldown in nine places with no number anywhere, and the level-6 phase gave none for Divine Judgment.
audit.why: Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 — a 22s rank-1 window is the entire punish opportunity, and Divine Judgment's 160s at rank 1 means one use per lane phase.
audit.corrected: 22s written into dosFull[0].d, breakdown.cooldowns and whys[5]; 160s into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions were missing. A Thousand Cuts heals Gwen off the damage it deals to champions, so extended trades turn on Grievous Wounds timing — the itemization line said only 'his healing'. And Skip 'n Slash grants attack speed, range and magic damage on-hit, so her trade damage scales with attack speed rather than being read off resistances alone.
audit.why: Both are listed in _missing for this matchup and both are stated in Riot's own text.
audit.corrected: report[8].t now names A Thousand Cuts as the heal to cut; breakdown.cooldowns now states Skip 'n Slash applies on-hit damage.

audit.why: packet.suspectNames flagged 'Pop Hallowed Mist' in wants.foe[1]; Hallowed Mist is Gwen's real W name, so it is a false positive.

edits.before: You are the weakest level 1 in the game — pay rent quietly. Identify how Gwen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: Both of you are weak at level 1 — you have one Q, she has one E charge, so pay rent quietly, set the wave, and do not gift her a free trade.

edits.before: E-poke softens his step-ups while you scale. Only take the trade when Gwen's Hallowed Mist is down.
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash (E) comes online and Snip Snip! true damage ignores your armour — give nothing and farm.

edits.before: Level 6 / 11 / 16 are the actual matchups — everything before is stalling. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Gwen's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Divine Ascent goes ranged and Divine Judgment (160s) covers her E dive — but she can W untargetable, so your Q whiffs on nothing.

edits.before: Nashor's plus missing-health Starfire (E) lets you out-range her dash and bully her off farm while her mist is down, force the trades here.
edits.after: Nashor's plus missing-health Starfire (E) out-ranges her dash, but Hallowed Mist (22s) resets every trade — you only win the windows it is down.

edits.before: She’s safe inside. Scale past it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist is 22s at rank 1 — step up only in the window it is down.

edits.before: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — She’s safe inside. Scale past it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Gwen Hallowed Mist: matchup-defining — 22s; Skip 'n Slash applies on-hit damage. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Nashor's Tooth  (the ramp begins), then Riftmaker / Rabadon's Deathcap; boots Mercury's Treads. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — his healing fights your pattern.
edits.after: Start Doran's Ring + 2 pots. Core: Nashor's Tooth (the ramp begins), then Riftmaker / Rabadon's Deathcap; boots Mercury's Treads. Anti-heal (Oblivion Orb / Executioner's) early — A Thousand Cuts heals her off you.

notes: Rows 0, 1 and 4 flipped as one atomic group to the packet chart; rows 2, 3 and 5 left with Gwen because the Gwen-side audit settled them there and the two directions must agree — whys[5] was softened to state the mist-down window instead of claiming the stage outright, so the prose no longer argues against its own row. Several full-layer strings still call Kayle 'he/his' (tradeGood, breakdown.feeding, dontsFull[0].d, report[12]); the Gwen-side audit flagged the same thing.
